title: Principal Database & Analytics Engineer
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

title: Product Data Analyst
description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants on a tap, send money to friends, track their spending, and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people actually use it. As the tribe scales, so does the need for sharp, reliable insight into how people actually use what we build.

We’re looking for a Product Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer — working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers, and alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and measure what matters.

If you’re motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence product decisions — this role is for you.

What you’ll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance for SumUp Consumer using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation, and behavioural analytics to identify opportunities and drive improvements
  • Support Product Managers in understanding customer journeys, engagement, conversion, and retention — helping to shape product strategy and priorities
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Define, monitor, and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs — covering activation, engagement, and retention — and evaluate the impact of product changes for stakeholders
  • Design, execute, and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, helping to embed a culture of experimentation across the Consumer tribe

title: Commercial Planning Senior Associate
description:
Commercial Planning Senior Associate

About the team

The Commercial Planning team sits at the heart of SumUp's commercial engine, turning complex data into the financial insight that shapes how we grow. We partner closely with channel leads, marketing, and product teams to make sure our planning is accurate, proactive, and genuinely useful to the people making decisions. We need someone who can own the analytical workstreams for our Acquisitions channels while building the kind of trusted relationships that make finance business partnering actually work. If you're energised by owning complex models, influencing commercial decisions, and being the person stakeholders turn to when they need clarity, this is the role for you.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end revenue and customer acquisition budget (CAB) planning for acquisition channels, building scalable financial models, running scenario analyses, and delivering proactive performance insights to senior stakeholders
  • Act as the primary finance business partner for channel leads, building trusted relationships, embedding financial models into commercial decision-making, and influencing assumptions through rigorous analysis
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses at country, merchant category, and channel level to surface revenue risks and opportunities, and present findings clearly to senior, non-technical audiences
  • Build business cases and product-level revenue forecasts to support existing and new product growth initiatives
  • Contribute to the migration of commercial planning from spreadsheets to scalable forecasting tools, and help reduce manual effort in month-end reporting workflows
  • Provide day-to-day guidance to an intern and/or analyst, helping them develop their skills and navigate complex analytical tasks

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Are you looking for a role where you can truly influence and manage your own book of business in a collaborative sales environment? We believe in entrepreneurialism and empower you to make decisions that will grow our business. We will provide you with all the resources needed to be a successful high-earning sales executive.  

The Senior Account Executive is responsible for driving ARR growth across a defined portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts. This role combines new business acquisition, account expansion and executive relationship management to help customers solve complex business challenges around data protection, governance, AI readiness and operational resilience. The successful candidate will create and execute territory and account plans, lead complex sales cycles, develop executive-level relationships and work collaboratively with partners and internal stakeholders to consistently exceed revenue targets. 

Key responsibilities:  

  • Develop and execute a territory plan to create pipeline, acquire new customers, expand strategic accounts and consistently exceed ARR and ACV targets.
